defaults.prompt: Create a new video of the person in the reference images performing the movements, gestures, facial expressions, steps, turns and timing of {{video_1}}, which is used only as a motion reference. Keep their face, hair, body and outfit exactly as in the reference images in every frame, and match the back-view image whenever their back is to the camera. Match the camera framing and the natural phone-video quality of {{video_1}}, with no glossy AI look. Do not use the face or identity of the person in {{video_1}}. One person only. No subtitles, no text, no music.

Replace the selected person in {{video_1}} with the reference character shown in the reference images, in every frame from the very first frame to the last. Replace the whole head and face, not only the clothing. Every reference image shows the same person: use them for identity only (face, head, hair, body and clothing), never for expression. Copy the mouth, lips, jaw and facial expression of the person in {{video_1}} in every frame: open, close and shape the mouth exactly when they do, so the lips stay in sync with the original audio. In every frame, face exactly the same direction as the person in {{video_1}}: front view when they face the camera, profile when they turn sideways, back view when they face away. Never change the direction they are facing. Preserve source performance, scene and audio timing.

actions.idempotency_description: Required for generate; optional for edits. Scoped to acting user and agent for 24 hours. Identical requests replay the stored response; changed requests conflict.

agent_id.description: The agent that owns the video workspace.

change_set_id.description: An optional stable edit-group identifier for undo and retry.

auto_regenerate.description: Whether the batch runs the automatic dependent-regeneration walk after its writes. False performs the writes and dispatches no dependent jobs; omitted keeps the current behaviour.

no_paid.description: Refuse paid media generation for this run. Text and LLM work still bills normally.

max_paid_operations.description: Maximum paid media reservations across all workspaces in this authenticated user/run, enforced atomically. Retries reuse their reservation.

spending_run_id.description: Stable run or conversation identity required with spending controls. The authenticated run owner shares one policy across workspaces.

actions.description: One action, or a compatible batch. Updates, generations (at most 50), variable creates and a video-scene edit group batch as before. A mix of create, update, reorder, duplicate and delete actions applies in array order, so a later action sees the records earlier actions created and may address them by ref; editing a record an earlier action deleted is refused, and deleting a record a create made earlier in the same batch is refused.

response_schema.title: Video editing action response
response_schema.description: Every success, pending, confirmation, payment, and error envelope returned by the Rails video-action endpoint.

results.description: Results in the same order as the submitted actions.

result.description: The persisted edit resource, generation job, delete preview result, or undo summary.

status.description: The current edit or asynchronous job status.

container_type.description: The Rails owner type for a generated take.

container_id.description: The cell or layer that owns the generated take.

card_type.description: The generation card that created the job.

reference_mapping.description: Provider attachment order grouped by creation-card field; prompt mentions use these stable labels.

row_count.description: The number of rows included in the CSV.

column_count.description: The number of Vidsheet columns included in the CSV.

uuid.description: The stable UUID of a created or duplicated Vidsheet; non-null in create and duplicate receipts.

agent_id.description: The agent that owns the created or duplicated Vidsheet.

vidsheet_project_id.description: The UUID used by the canonical editable Vidsheet route.

deleted.description: Whether the requested resource was deleted.

total_estimated_credits.description: The summed pre-dispatch credit estimate for a column generate.

rows.description: The per-row dispatch ledger of a column generate.

cell_id.description: The row's cell in the generated column; null when the row has no cell in it.

status.description: Whether this row dispatched a job, would dispatch it on a preview, was refused, or held no card to run.

error.description: Why this row did not dispatch.

change_set_id.description: The undoable edit group, when the actions changed stored video data.

refs.description: The persisted id of every record a create named with a ref.

auto_regeneration.description: One entry per dependent the batch examined, the string "skipped" when the caller sent auto_regenerate false, and absent when no dependent was examined.

status.description: The regeneration outcome for this dependent.

user_job_id.description: The dispatched or replayed job, when one exists.

error.description: Why this dependent was not regenerated.

contract_version.description: The exact Rails video-action contract revision.

status.description: The prerequisite or source is not ready yet.

retryable.description: Retry the identical request and idempotency key.

job_ids.description: The running prerequisite jobs a generation_pending caller follows or resumes; absent on a source wait and on a preview.

dispatched_job_ids.description: Final jobs earlier actions of the same generate batch already dispatched; present only when there are any, including when the pending action is a preview.

anyOf.description: An accepted generation that needs an identical retry.

error_code.description: The destructive action needs explicit confirmation.

would_destroy.description: The authoritative Rails preview bound to the token.

token_rejected.description: Why a supplied token did not authorize this preview.

anyOf.description: A validation, conflict, credit, or payment response from the Rails action boundary.

schema.description: The generated schema revision that rejected the request.

fragment.description: The JSON Pointer to the rejected request value.

failed_attribute.description: The JSON Schema keyword that rejected the value.

retryable.description: Whether retrying can succeed without changing the action.

new_change_set_required.description: Whether the caller must begin a new edit group.

funding_error_kind.description: The credit or payment failure category.

x402_credit_purchase.description: A typed x402 quote or credit-plan requirement.
